subject: Collection protocol choice — signed webhook token & VAT handoff

Cc: AP Team <ap-team@acme-health.com>
Date: Thu, 18 Jun 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Onboarding: how should we receive invoices and VAT evidence?

Hi Rachel / Ben,

We're ready to accept invoices from Redwood for the Q3 deployment. Before we flip the switch, our AP team needs to confirm the delivery method and how you're going to provide VAT evidence for our EU entity. Two notes up front:

- Our preference is an automated push (webhook or SFTP) — we try to keep manual email attachments to a minimum.
- For tax, we need a signed VAT certificate (EU) attached to the first invoice and a way to correlate VAT IDs to invoice line items.

Can you confirm:
1) Do you support a signed webhook token (we rotate keys quarterly) or would you need us to enroll in your portal?
2) If webhook, what does the token rotation look like and how do you send VAT evidence?
3) If portal, can you provide an SSO/OAuth step-by-step for our vendor onboarding team?

I attached our PO and the VAT cert for reference.

Thanks,
Samantha Lee
Director, Accounts Payable
Acme Health
Attachment: acme_po_4521.pdf (application/pdf)
Attachment: acme_eu_vat_certificate.pdf (application/pdf)

From: rachel_kim@redwood.com <rachel_kim@redwood.com>
To: Samantha Lee <finance@acme-health.com>
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.com, kimberly_park@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 18 Jun 2026 11:06:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Onboarding: how should we receive invoices and VAT evidence?

Hi Samantha — thanks for the clear summary and for attaching the PO and VAT cert. Short answer: both options are supported; we typically recommend the signed webhook token for partners who want a fully automated push with minimal manual steps. Details below.

Option A — Signed webhook push (recommended for automation):
- We issue a signed, time-bound token (JWT) scoped to your vendor id. Tokens are valid for 90 days by default.
- We include a token refresh endpoint and can rotate keys quarterly; we publish a key-fingerprints endpoint for metadata.
- Payloads: JSON POST to your secure listener with invoice metadata + base64 PDF link. VAT evidence: first invoice payload will include a VAT metadata object and a URL to the signed VAT certificate (stored on our secure object store for 90 days).
- Delivery guarantees: retries with exponential backoff for 72 hours; fallback copies (PDF) will be sent to the billing contact email if delivery fails.

Option B — Redwood Portal enrollment (recommended for customers wanting portal audit trail):
- Portal supports SSO via SAML/OAuth (Okta, Azure AD).
- Invoices are visible in the portal UI; VAT certificates are uploaded to the invoice record.
- Portal also supports manual download and push to your systems via an API webhook.

Questions / requests from our side:
1) For webhook, please provide the hostname and port for the listener and whether you accept TLS client certs. If you prefer SFTP, send the target SFTP endpoint and username.
2) Confirm the AP contact we'll notify on fallback (email).
3) Any special schema requirement for invoice line-level VAT tags? We have an internal JSON schema (link below), and can produce UBL/XML sample if needed.

Next steps: if you want webhook, we can send a short technical packet with the token exchange flow and a sample payload. If portal, we'll have Kimberly kick off SSO setup and send a portal invite.

Best,
Rachel Kim
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
Mobile: +1 415-555-0198
Attachment: redwood_webhook_flyer.pdf (application/pdf)
Related link: https://na1-docs.redwood.com/ap-schema/invoice-v1.json

Hi all,

Jumping in from Acme's engineering side. A few clarifications from our security & AP automation team:

- We prefer the signed webhook model but we require: mutual TLS on the listener or a signed JWT with a rotating HMAC key. We can't accept static bearer tokens.
- Token rotation cadence: quarterly is fine, but we need an automated rotation endpoint (we can call your token refresh endpoint).
- VAT evidence must include the certificate fingerprint in the invoice payload (SHA-256) so our accounting system can validate the file after download.

If you can provide a short sample of the JWT exchange and a payload with the VAT fingerprint, we can provision a test listener and validate before production.

Thanks,
J. Morales
Sr. Engineer, AP Integrations
Acme Health

Thanks Jaime — that's helpful. We're aligned on mutual TLS or signed JWT. I'll propose a short pilot plan below so we can validate the end-to-end flow and the VAT fingerprint check:

Pilot plan (timeline estimate):
- Day 0: Acme provides test listener endpoint (mutual TLS cert or JWT key exchange) + a test VAT cert to compute fingerprint.
- Day 1: Redwood spins up test invoice push using a staging token; we send a sample payload (invoice JSON + VAT fingerprint + PDF link).
- Day 2: Acme validates fingerprint and confirms the PDF download/verifies signature.
- Day 3: We flip to production token and sign the first live invoice.

Action items (for AP/Engineering):
- Samantha / Jaime: share test listener hostname, preferred auth method (mTLS or JWT), and the AP notification email for fallbacks.
- Ben: I looped you in to confirm our production retry policy and retention window for VAT files (90 days). Can we shorten to 30 days if Acme prefers?
- Kimberly: can you start the portal invite in parallel in case they prefer SSO?

Samantha — once you confirm the listener details we'll send the technical packet with the exact JWT exchange, sample payload, and a sandbox certificate.

Best regards,
Rachel Kim
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
